title: Bank Call for Spouse
scenario: A caller says your spouse’s account is compromised and asks you to move family savings.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.C: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Bank Call for Spouse: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Banks never ask you to move money to a safe account.
